name: @nexgen/storefront-engine
description: The Theme Engine's own resolution contract, the Storefront Engine (Section-tree walking + component resolution), default Storefront Component Engine primitives, the Gateway typed client, and the normalized Store Context — per docs/frontend/THEME_ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/frontend/STOREFRONT_COMPONENT_ENGINE.md, and docs/frontend/STORE_API_GATEWAY_ARCHITECTURE.md. Consumed only by apps/storefront, per ADR-0009. React is pinned to ^18.3 (Next.js 15 supports 18 or 19) to match @nexgen/ui's own peer dependency exactly — @nexgen/ui ships raw .tsx source (no build step), so a React major-version mismatch across workspace packages produces real, un-ignorable JSX type conflicts rather than a runtime issue; pinning is the actual fix, found and applied during Beta Milestone 1.
